research_question: To construct the AICC2023 chronology for the EPICA Dome C ice core, the researchers merged new gas measurements with prior 100-800 ka baseline records of atmospheric δ18O and δO2/N2. What are the PANGAEA dataset IDs for these prior baseline records?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are establishing a new chronology for the EPICA Dome C ice core. Alongside our own new high-resolution gas data we need the existing 100-800 ka records of delta 18Oatm and delta O2/N2 compiled by Extier et al. (2018), which provide the baseline over the full 800 kyr. Could you search PANGAEA and find the specific dataset DOIs for those two baseline records?

phase_2.user_prompt: Now that we have the DOIs for the baseline Extier et al. (2018) datasets (10.1594/PANGAEA.887323 and 10.1594/PANGAEA.887326), please retrieve them. We want to extract the data tables into memory, specifically noting the AICC2012 gas age and the delta 18Oatm or delta O2/N2 values, so we could theoretically replicate the noise-removal and merging steps described in the AICC2023 study.
